title: MOASYS-Vault — Shared definitions
description: Definitions reused across the per-type catalog schemas (movies, shows, music, audiobooks).

Version.description: One physical copy of a media item — where it lives (category) and what quality it is.

category.description: Subfolder under root_path where the copy lives. Literal 'default' for flat libraries (no categories configured).

quality.description: For movies/shows: the bucket from quality_thresholds the file's long edge falls into (UHD/HD/SD), or null when no bucket matches. For music/audiobooks: the uppercase file extension (FLAC, MP3, M4B, AAC, ...).
